user.title: Fujitsu Waterstage
user.description: Address of the RS-485 to TCP gateway and the Modbus slave address of the FWS-MBIO-002 board. Setup verifies that the board really is an MBIO before it goes any further.

data_description.slave_id: Set with DIP switch SW2[1-4] on the board. Other devices may share this gateway, so the address has to be right.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the gateway or from that slave address.
error.unknown_device: Something answered, but it is not an FWS-MBIO-002 board (register 9900 did not return 0x0401). Check the slave address before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This board is already set up.

init.title: Options
init.description: Which parts of the installation to poll, how often, and how much of the parameter surface may be written.

data_description.blocks: Discovery filled these in. Turn a block on if it exists but was not detected.
data_description.write_level: basic writes only the everyday setpoints. advanced exposes every writable parameter. expert also exposes the registers that switch physical outputs and restart hardware.
data_description.scan_interval_fast: The board refreshes these values from the BSB bus every 30 s at best, so a shorter interval only loads the bus.
data_description.inter_request_delay_ms: Idle time left on the RS-485 bus for other devices.
data_description.room_sensors: Heating circuits that have a room temperature sensor. Only those get a thermostat entity; the others keep a mode select and a setpoint number, because a thermostat with no current temperature is misleading.

options.expert: expert - also relay tests and restarts
